headline: Marui Group disclosed that the breach of PLAID’s KARTE platform exposed 8.83 million Marui records and 8.5 million Epos Card records, with possible overlap. Illinois is investigating an apparent cyberattack attempt at Algonquin Dam and says the dam remained operational.

incidents.what: Marui Group confirmed that unauthorized access at marketing vendor PLAID exposed Marui retail and Epos Card data.
incidents.scale: 8.83M Marui records and 8.5M Epos records; not a unique-person count

incidents.what: Reuters relayed CNN’s report of an investigation into apparent unauthorized access to the national crime database and said the FBI did not respond to its request for comment.
CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver.
incidents.scale: Known exploited vulnerability; victim count not disclosed

incidents.what: Universeum told guests that an attack on booking supplier Visit Group International exposed contact information.
incidents.scale: About 280,000 contact records; no payment data reported exposed

incidents.what: Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Austria’s foreign ministry said intruders accessed its externally hosted website and viewed staff names and work contact details.
Illinois disclosed an investigation into an apparent cyberattack attempt at Algonquin Dam; the agency said the dam remained operational.
Tigerfish secured a publicly exposed storage system holding customer transcription material after being alerted to the issue.
Kurly said unauthorized access exposed curator-program data and two other customers’ member numbers.
NBC News reported that unauthorized parties accessed a farmer-payment system in the incident that disrupted USDA systems earlier in the week.
SEGA Fave began restoring online play for more arcade games on a trial basis after the ALL.Net and Aime outage.
Rokkatei’s second notice said customer personal information may also have been exposed in the online shop incident.
